in_hebrew.name: ברני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Berny is derived from the Hebrew word 'beren' which means 'strong' or 'powerful'. The name Berny is a diminutive form of the name Bernard, which means 'son of the strong one'.

in_greek.name: Βερνης
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Berny is derived from the Greek word 'bernēs', which means 'son of the bear'. The name Berny is a diminutive form of the name Bernard, which has a similar meaning in Greek.
